mapper.sql: select o.id, o.platform_type as platform, o.order_id as orderNo, o.sub_order_no as subOrderNo, o.item_id as itemId, o.item_title as itemTitle, o.order_amount as orderAmount, o.line_status as status, o.paid_time as paidTime, o.received_time as receivedTime, o.settle_time as settleTime, a.user_id as attributedUserId, a.method as attributionMethod, a.confidence as attributionConfidence from sys_order_commission o left join cps_attribution a on a.id = (select max(a2.id) from cps_attribution a2 where a2.order_line_id = o.id and a2.is_current = 1)
mapper.select: select user_id as userId, method, confidence, decided_by as decidedBy, is_current as isCurrent, created_at as createdAt from cps_attribution where order_line_id = #{id} order by id

select from_status as fromStatus, to_status as toStatus, previous_status as previousStatus, recovered_amount as recoveredAmount, source, created_at as createdAt from cps_order_event where order_line_id = #{id} order by id

select o.id, o.platform_type as platform, o.order_id as orderNo, o.sub_order_no as subOrderNo, o.item_title as itemTitle, o.order_amount as orderAmount, o.paid_time as paidTime, case when o.line_status in ('INVALID', 'FULL_REFUND') then '已退款' when o.line_status in ('RECEIVED', 'SETTLED') and exists (select 1 from cps_settle_item s where s.order_line_id = o.id and s.user_id = #{userId} and s.status = 'CREDITED') then '已结算' when o.line_status = 'PAID' then '待收货' when o.line_status in ('RECEIVED', 'SETTLED') then '冻结中' else null end as displayStatus from sys_order_commission o where exists (select 1 from cps_attribution a where a.user_id = #{userId} and a.id = (select max(a2.id) from cps_attribution a2 where a2.order_line_id = o.id and a2.is_current = 1)) order by o.id desc
